name: Historic City of Trogir
description: Trogir is a walled old town on a tiny island between the Croatian mainland and the island of Čiovo, about 27 kilometres west of Split on the Adriatic coast. Its grid of narrow lanes goes back to Hellenistic times. Walking through, you pass Romanesque churches and Renaissance and Baroque buildings left by centuries of Venetian rule, all within a few compact blocks.
